{{Hatnote|This page is printed Decipher cards plus original Virtual Sets 1–7 (Players Committee PDF slips). It is not the post-2014 [[Virtual Set 7]] and not a GEMP environment.}}
'''Premiere - Original VS7''' is the constructed pool of printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] and [[Reflections III]] plus original [[Players Committee]] Virtual Sets 1–7. [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire|Virtual Set 7]] was in play by 19 July 2004.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20051102154456/http://gameplayersnetwork.com/card/decks.asp?gm=starwars&id=5733 Darth Hoth, GPN deck 5733] (Wayback), 19 July 2004: "With the release of V set 7"</ref> The short name '''POVS7''' is used in GEMP importable deck file names.

Wiki decklists use this format when the newest original-era virtual card in the list comes from Virtual Set 7.
